note: The v14 API reference. Measurably collides with typo3-rector (0.155) and typo3-batch (0.139), and is conceptually confusable with typo3-14-update. The negative cases pin all three boundaries.

evals.prompt: What is the correct way to build a Fluid view in a TYPO3 v14 controller - ViewFactory or the old view interface?
evals.note: Pure API-shape question about code that already exists. No migration, no tooling.

evals.prompt: Show me how to register a backend module in TYPO3 v14 and what the TCA for a simple record should look like.
evals.note: Writing new v14 code from scratch.

evals.prompt: Which PSR-14 event replaces the old post-processing hook in v14, and what is its namespace?
evals.note: API lookup. Must be verified against installed source, never guessed.

evals.prompt: How do I write a QueryBuilder query in v14 without SQL injection risk?
Run the automated migration to fix the deprecated calls across this extension.
evals.note: Measured collision (0.155): both mention migrations and deprecated APIs. Discriminator is AUTOMATION - applying a tool is typo3-rector; explaining the target API is typo3-update.

evals.prompt: Migrate the FlexForms and TypoScript in this sitepackage to v14.
evals.note: Non-PHP migration belongs to Fractor, not the API reference.

evals.prompt: Upgrade this whole site from TYPO3 12 to 14.3 in DDEV and make sure nothing changes visually.
evals.note: The confusion this repo most needs pinned. A whole-project upgrade is never this skill.

evals.prompt: Apply the same hook-to-event change across all 30 extensions in packages/.
evals.note: Measured collision (0.139). Discriminator is SCALE: one API explained here; the same change repeated across many extensions is typo3-batch.

evals.prompt: Set up a Kubernetes ingress for our staging cluster.
evals.note: Unrelated domain. No TYPO3 skill may fire.
